classification.difficultyReason: The kite requires converting units, identifying which diagonal is bisected, finding two unequal diagonal sections with Pythagoras, and combining them before calculating area; other parts require inferring horizontal offsets.

content.prompt: Find the missing sides, then find the area. Round your answer to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Unfilled trapezium with horizontal bases, a vertical right edge and a left edge sloping up-right. Both right vertices have right-angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Top base 10 cm, bottom base 18 cm, left side 10 cm. Coordinates use the resulting 6 cm height without displaying it.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and right-angle marks are visible.

spec.description: Oblique unfilled kite pointing down-right, with both diagonals dashed. Short equal sides have single ticks; long equal sides have double ticks. An external dimension measures the complete diagonal joining the left and upper-right vertices.
spec.mathematics: Complete bisected diagonal 76 cm; short equal sides 53 cm; long equal sides 1.3 m. The other diagonal comprises sqrt(53²−38²)+sqrt(130²−38²) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original 76 cm, 53 cm and 1.3 m givens, dashed diagonals and equality ticks are visible.

answer.worked:
$1.3\text{ m}=130\text{ cm}$. The kite's symmetry diagonal bisects the $76\text{ cm}$ diagonal at right angles. Let its two sections be $p$ and $q$.

$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{76}{2}=38\text{ cm}\\p&=\sqrt{53^2-38^2}=\sqrt{1365}\text{ cm}\\q&=\sqrt{130^2-38^2}=\sqrt{15456}\text{ cm}\\d&=\sqrt{1365}+\sqrt{15456}\text{ cm}\\d&\approx161.3\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{76(\sqrt{1365}+\sqrt{15456})}{2}\\A&\approx6128.2\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled trapezium with horizontal bases and outward-sloping sides. Dashed perpendiculars descend from both top vertices with right-angle marks at their feet. Separate external dimensions label both base overhangs.

spec.answerVisibility: Only source dimensions, dashed perpendiculars and right-angle marks are visible.

answer.short: Height $=12.0\text{ cm}$; bottom base $=18.0\text{ cm}$; right side $\approx12.4\text{ cm}$; $A=168.0\text{ cm}^2$.
answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the bottom base and $r$ the right sloping side.

$$\begin{align*}b&=5+10+3\\b&=18\text{ cm}\\h&=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}\\h&=12\text{ cm}\\r&=\sqrt{12^2+3^2}\\r&\approx12.4\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{12}{2}(10+18)\\A&=168.0\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Height $\approx2.8\text{ cm}$; bottom base $=8.0\text{ cm}$; left side $\approx4.1\text{ cm}$; $A\approx17.0\text{ cm}^2$.
answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the bottom base and $l$ the left sloping side.

$$\begin{align*}b&=3+4+1\\b&=8\text{ cm}\\h&=\sqrt{3^2-1^2}\\h&=\sqrt8\text{ cm}\\h&\approx2.8\text{ cm}\\l&=\sqrt{(\sqrt8)^2+3^2}=\sqrt{17}\text{ cm}\\l&\approx4.1\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{\sqrt8}{2}(4+8)\\A&\approx17.0\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.answerVisibility: The original top base 3 cm, bottom base 7 cm, height 4 cm, exterior offset 3 cm and right-angle mark remain visible. The erroneous 9 cm right-side label is omitted; no computed side or area is printed.

answer.short: Left side $=5.0\text{ cm}$; right side $\approx8.1\text{ cm}$; $A=20.0\text{ cm}^2$.
answer.worked:
Let $l$ and $r$ be the left and right sloping sides. The horizontal separation of the right-side endpoints is $3+7-3=7\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{align*}l&=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}\\l&=5.0\text{ cm}\\r&=\sqrt{7^2+4^2}\\r&=\sqrt{65}\text{ cm}\\r&\approx8.1\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac4{2}(3+7)\\A&=20.0\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
